sources.name: ISTAT — Codici statistici delle unità amministrative territoriali
sources.description: The statistics office's list of municipalities, provinces and regions with their statistical codes, updated at every change of the territory.

sources.name: Agenzia delle Entrate — Catasto
sources.description: The cadastre of Italy outside the provinces of Trento and Bolzano, which keep their own land register: parcels and building units by municipality, sheet, parcel and unit, and the cadastral codes of the municipalities. No connector of this repository reads it yet.
sources.license: Agenzia delle Entrate terms of use (not verified)

sources.name: GSE — Gruppi di autoconsumatori e comunità di energia rinnovabile
sources.description: The page of the energy services manager on the configurations of shared self-consumption: the decree of incentives, its operating rules, the maps of the areas each primary substation serves and the portal where a configuration asks for the service, which a connector would read under the configuration's own credentials.

sources.name: Decreto legislativo 8 novembre 2021, n. 199 — attuazione della direttiva (UE) 2018/2001 sulla promozione dell'uso dell'energia da fonti rinnovabili
sources.description: The transposition of the renewable energy directive: individual self-consumers, including at a distance (article 30), groups of self-consumers acting jointly (article 30), renewable energy communities (article 31) and the incentives for shared energy (article 8), as amended by the decree-law 13/2023 and the decree-law 19/2025 (article 1-bis).

sources.name: Decreto del Ministro dell'ambiente e della sicurezza energetica 7 dicembre 2023, n. 414 (decreto CACER)
sources.description: The decree of the incentives for the configurations of self-consumption for sharing renewable energy (CACER): a premium tariff on the shared energy for twenty years from each plant's entry into operation, plants of up to 1 MW, and a capital grant of up to 40 % in small municipalities; in force from 24 January 2024. Read through the energy services manager's page and the Chamber of Deputies' dossier.
sources.attribution: Ministero dell'Ambiente e della Sicurezza Energetica

sources.name: Camera dei deputati — Le configurazioni per l'autoconsumo diffuso
sources.description: The Chamber of Deputies' research note on the configurations of shared self-consumption, updated on 13 June 2025: energy may be shared within one market zone, and the incentive is paid only on the energy shared by plants and consumption points connected under the same primary substation.

sources.name: ARERA — Testo integrato autoconsumo diffuso (TIAD), allegato A alla deliberazione 27 dicembre 2022, 727/2022/R/eel
sources.description: The regulator's rules on the configurations of shared self-consumption: the shared energy, the self-consumed energy within the area of one primary substation, and the restitution of network components, as amended by the deliberation 15/2024/R/eel; it replaced the deliberation 318/2020/R/eel from 1 March 2023 at the earliest.
sources.attribution: ARERA — Autorità di Regolazione per Energia Reti e Ambiente

sources.name: ARERA — deliberazione 19 marzo 2019, 103/2019/R/eel, the configuration of the market zones from 2021
sources.description: The regulator's approval of the zones of the relevant grid from 1 January 2021: Umbria moved from the centre-north zone to the centre-south zone, and the Calabria zone replaced the limited production pole of Rossano.
sources.attribution: ARERA — Autorità di Regolazione per Energia Reti e Ambiente

sources.name: GME — Zone del mercato elettrico (18 October 2023)
sources.description: The market operator's list of the zones of the day-ahead market and the regions each geographical zone covers.

sources.name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform — Area list with Energy Identification Code (EIC)
sources.description: The list of the areas of the transparency platform with their EIC codes and functions: bidding zones (BZN), control areas (CTA), scheduling and market balance areas.

sources.name: Decreto del Presidente della Repubblica 26 ottobre 1972, n. 633 — istituzione e disciplina dell'imposta sul valore aggiunto
sources.description: The VAT act: the ordinary rate (article 16) and the reduced rates of table A; part III, number 103, gives 10 % to electricity for domestic use.

sources.name: Agenzia delle Entrate — risposta all'interpello 3 marzo 2021, n. 142
sources.description: The tax agency's answer on the electricity of the common parts of a condominium: not a domestic use, taxed at the ordinary rate, unless the condominium is made only of dwellings whose electricity serves domestic uses alone.

sources.name: Decreto legislativo 25 novembre 2024, n. 190 — disciplina dei regimi amministrativi per la produzione di energia da fonti rinnovabili (testo unico FER)
sources.description: The single act on the permits of renewable plants, in force from 30 December 2024: free activity (annex A), the simplified procedure PAS (annex B) and the single authorisation (annex C), as amended in 2025. No value of the pack reads it yet.
